testcase.name: a new profile is incomplete until the wizard is filled
security level 0 requires a justification (EN 50126-1 7.4.2.1 d))
security levels not yet implemented cannot be selected
first confirmation needs no reason; later changes need one and are logged
projects without a profile are migrated with defaults and marked
confidential projects may only use the local model
the pipeline refuses a blocked call before contacting any provider
reports show the profile, its change log and the security statement
